title: 第7章  别碰那里第8章  姐姐就是放得开
slug: 恶女超会撩深陷兽夫雄竞修罗场
content_zh:
季欢听着他低沉暗哑的声音，这家伙，怎么会有这样的恶趣呀？
他的大手开始不老实了，窜进了她的衣服里。
季欢气息不稳，这家伙，不得不说，确实挺会。
他只要出手，她就根本招架不住。
她看小说的时候，就知道，这裴西川在床上是个厉害的角色。
现实里也是个厉害的霸总，做生意的手段了得，富可敌国。
他的手指精准无识的找到她的弱点。
季欢轻呼一声。
“不要！”
她现在这副鬼样子，绝对不能被他引诱。
不然，她立马就会被当成怪物送去怪物研究局。
裴西川吻着她的脖子，闻着她身上那淡淡和甜香味，他对她的味道实在是喜欢。
那晚，根本不够，他想要更多个夜晚。
季欢听着他粗重的呼吸声，以及他手上的力度，她知道，他已经快要失控了。
雄性兽人一旦发情，就根本停不下来的，如果不得到抚慰，会精力狂暴，会出问题的。
“裴总，裴总，你冷静点，这里是公司，不行的。而且，而且我身体不舒服。头好痛呀！”
她赶紧装病，不然，等一会就一发不可收拾了。
裴西川重重一喘，手指间的滑嫩实在是诱人，还有她身上的味道。
但，她头疼，没办法。
裴西川抱紧她，缓缓阖下眸子，让自己平静。

季欢能感觉到他的气息缓下来了，身体也没那么烫了。
她才稍稍安心。
“裴总，你能松开我了吗？我得去吃药了。”
裴西川把她翻了个身，让她面对着他。
“季欢，我知道你喜欢永夜，但我缺个床伴。”
他长指抚上她的脖颈，他的目光里带着几丝贪恋。
“我和你很合拍，以后我们两个就固定见面，你看可以吗？”
季欢看着他那目光，克制又隐忍。
但床伴这两个字，她听起来有点不爽。
可是，想到他是程永夜的好兄弟，又觉得睡他很爽。
报复渣男的方式，就应该是这样的。
这家伙，颜值身材俱佳，而且还很有钱，贵族出生。
她在她那个世界，可遇不到这样的极品，那就玩玩呗！
content_en:
Ji Huan listened to his deep and hoarse voice, how could this guy have such a bad taste?
His big hands became dishonest and got into her clothes.
Ji Huan's breath was unstable. This guy, I have to say, was really good at it.
As long as he takes action, she won't be able to resist him at all.
When she read the novel, she knew that Pei Xichuan was a powerful character in bed.
In reality, he is also a powerful boss, with excellent business skills and wealth that rivals the country.
His fingers found her weak points with precision and unconsciousness.
Ji Huan shouted softly.
"No!"
She must not be seduced by him in the way she looks now.
Otherwise, she will be immediately treated as a monster and sent to the Monster Research Bureau.
Pei Xichuan kissed her neck and smelled the light and sweet fragrance on her body. He really liked the smell of her.
That night was simply not enough, and he wanted more nights.
Ji Huan heard his heavy breathing and the strength of his hands, and she knew that he was almost out of control.
Once a male orc goes into estrus, he simply cannot stop. If he is not comforted, he will become violently energetic and may cause problems.
"Mr. Pei, Mr. Pei, calm down, this is a company, it's okay. Besides, I'm not feeling well. My head hurts!"
She quickly pretended to be sick, otherwise she would get out of control after a while.
Pei Xichuan breathed heavily, the smoothness between his fingers was really tempting, as well as the smell of her body.
But, she had a headache and there was nothing she could do.
Pei Xichuan hugged her tightly and slowly closed his eyes to calm himself.
Ji Huan could feel that his breath had slowed down and his body was no longer so hot.
She felt a little relieved.
"Mr. Pei, can you let go of me? I have to take medicine."
Pei Xichuan turned her over so that she faced him.
"Ji Huan, I know you like Yong Ye, but I need a bed partner."
His long fingers touched her neck, and there was a hint of lust in his eyes.
"You and I are very compatible. From now on, we will meet regularly. Do you think that's okay?"
Ji Huan looked at his gaze with restraint and forbearance.
But the word bed partner made her sound a little uncomfortable.
However, thinking that he was Cheng Yongye's good brother, she felt comfortable sleeping with him.
This is how you should take revenge on a scumbag.
This guy has good looks and a good figure, and is also very rich. He was born into a noble family.
In her world, she can't meet such a superb person, so just have fun!
